formal_core: Unchanged Lean sources and build records; no new Lean build or formalization is claimed.
new_written_proofs: Two lower factors: analytic local reconstruction with variable initial data is equivalent to uniform forward or reciprocal product decay; elementary positive-forcing converse.
Every-pair dichotomies give a bounded right inverse in arbitrary lower bandwidth, with variable initial entries.
Distinct positive limits and distinct periodic geometric means are sufficient in any order.
Analytic normalized LDU transfers to prescribed lower and upper PBFs with pairwise dichotomies. A maximum-limit product less than one is a sufficient condition for analytic LDU.
A positive exchange places the smaller limit below and larger limit above. For inverted limits, residuals relative to input entries decay geometrically.
Every ordered root partition with distinct parameters, and every positive upper-lower product with distinct positive limiting parameters, admits variable-data reconstruction.
